inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

row.name: A+ Kidz Care Learning Center 3, LLC

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During the course of an investigation, it was determined that a caregiver would hit a child on the foot for discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required: One out of ten personnel files evaluated lacked documentation of current SIDS/Shaken Baby training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training - Caregivers of Children Under 24 Months Required (26 TAC §746.1309(d))

occurrences.finding: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age: Two children who were forty-six  months old were combined with a thirteen month old. There is more than an eighteen months difference between the youngest and the oldest child.    Note: This was corrected when the children were moved to another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/Caregiver Ratio - 18 Months Difference in Age (26 TAC §746.1605(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: One infant feeding instructions had not been updated since May 2024.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children: A caregiver was observed telling two children not to go into the staff lounge because there are monsters in there.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion: One out of ten personnel records evaluated lacked documentation of having a high school diploma, GED, or equivalent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Additional Minimum Qualifications for Caregivers - HS Diploma, Equivalent, Certification of Completion (26 TAC §746.1107(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Four items were missing from two first aid kits on the buses used to transport children.    Note: This was corrected when the director obtained the items for the kit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit: Three out of ten personnel records evaluated lacked an employee affidavit.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2985) (26 TAC §746.901(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: One out of ten personnel records evaluated lacked current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation: Three out of ten personnel files evaluated lacked acknowledgment of receiving orientation to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Orientation (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Three out of ten children's files evaluated lacked a current shot record on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §746.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: Two out of ten personnel records evaluated lacked current first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was observed coming out of the restroom unsupervised.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days: Three infant feeding instructions have not been updated within the past thirty days.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Review and Update Every 30 Days (26 TAC §746.2421(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: Based on information gathered during the investigation, caregivers have reportedly been observed yelling at children.    The operation reported that they have addressed this issue with the caregivers to prevent further incidents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(5))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on information gathered during the investigation, a caregiver threatened to "pop" another employee's child, at that employee's request when they were misbehaving while in care.    The operation reported that they have addressed this issue with the caregivers to prevent further incidents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One out of ten children's files evaluated lacked an address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))

occurrences.finding: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies: One out of ten children's files evaluated lacked parent acknowledgment of receiving the operational policies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Provide Parents With Copy of Policies (26 TAC §746.503)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed a person to be present at the operation before receiving notice from the CBCU regarding the person's eligibility. The person's background check is listed as inactive.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area: A caregiver failed to sanitized the diaper changing table after changing children's diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures - Sanitizing Diaper Changing Area (26 TAC §746.3505(e))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver failed to wash children's hands after changing their diapers.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: Soiled diapers were stored in tied bag and placed on a counter where food is served in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver failed to wash her hands after changing a child's diaper.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway: Based on information gathered through a DFPS investigation, cots were observed to be touching one another, leaving no walkway or way for children to exit the room without stepping over cots.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Provides Access to Walkway (26 TAC §746.2909(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Operation allowed a person to be present at the operation with an inactive background check.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Children in Control: Children in the two year old room were observed to be out of control.    Note: This was corrected when the director stepped in to get the room back in control.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Interact positively with children (26 TAC §746.1203(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter: Based on information gathered, the operation allowed a person to be present at the operation after the CBCU has  notified the operation that the person is  ineligible to be present.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check determination - If ineligible then you must immediately remove subject from operation and confirm to CBCU receipt of notice letter (26 TAC §745.635(2))

occurrences.finding: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes: Based on information gathered during the investigation, infants are seated in car seats for more than fifteen minutes at a time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Activities for Infants - Not in Restrictive Device for more than 15 Minutes (26 TAC §746.2417(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials: In the toddler classroom, a bottle of Clorox bleach and a bottle of "Scrubbing Bubbles" (bathroom cleaner) was stored in the children's bathroom, in an unsecured cabinet under the sink making it accessible to children.     NOTE: CORRECTED AT TIME OF INSPECTION
occurrences.violation_type_title: Using, Storing and Disposing of Hazardous Materials (26 TAC §746.3407(13))

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child: A caregiver in the infant room was observed turning her back to a child who was on the changing table.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - If Above Floor Level Caregiver Must Face Child and Be Within Arm's Length of Child (26 TAC §746.3503(c)(3))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Through information received with this investigation;the documentation provided by the operation does not have the parent's signature acknowledging they received a copy of the incident report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits: Child was observed laying on his mat which was blocking an emergency exit doorway posing a hazard.     NOTE: This was corrected at inspection with the child's mat being moved out of the doorway.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment - Not Blocking Entrances or Exits (26 TAC §746.2909(1))
